integrity: Analytic proof of fixed-age moments and universal renewal inequality; finite independently executable quadrature and sampling-grid assertions; no claim of independent review or certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three ordered GUE eigenvalues from zero-matrix Brownian diffusion, complete simultaneous stationary-renewal resets; positive finite first and second inter-reset moments; not asserted for other dimensions, Dyson indices, partial resets or nonstationary clocks.
title: Universal sign reversal of adjacent GUE spacings under stationary renewal resetting
